objective: Prepare exactly two independent response-exam WorkBlocks only after four distinct durable candidate RETURNs exist, without exposing raw private prompt text or inventing execution claims.

inputs.independence: four distinct candidate ordinals, worker_ids and durable return_refs for one request_id

rubric_contract.public_output: concise observable rubric result + durable refs only

forbidden: counting prepared candidate cards as candidate returns
counting duplicate worker_ids or return_refs as independent
claiming exam completion before durable independent exam RETURNs
truth_boundary: Two prepared exam WorkBlocks prove judge capacity is prepared, not that judges ran. Synthesis may count exams only from durable independent exam RETURNs.
